blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines –Sibol’s first Pokémon UNITE match at the Asian Games esports competition was forfeited Friday due to a uniform-related violation. The Philippines and Kazakhstan were both disqualified from their scheduled match because of a noncompliance issue with uniform regulations. Both teams were marked as did not start (DNS) on the official Asian Games website results page.
